name: packaging-config

spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.32.0 (minor, LIB-REFRESH — audit-wave RECONCILE fixes): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.31.0 -> 0.32.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so it carries verify-integrate 0.12.0 + scheduling 0.46.0 + implement 0.11.1's sources — lib/verify_integrate.py (all disposable-worktree git ops in reconcile_rebase_worktree + the GATE helper run -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null so the target repo's post-checkout hook can't wedge tier-1; gh_closing_issue_ref uses gh api graphql + a Closes #N body fallback instead of the unsupported closingIssuesReferences --json field), lib/run_tick.py (_reconcile_ledger_seed derives a canonical owner/repo#N issue_ref by stripping the -wo suffix), and lib/open_pr.py (implementer worktree add runs hooks-free).
